findings.passage: On the small feature she said in July 2025 she was preparing to direct, written with Vanessa Burghardt, who played her daughter in _Cha Cha Real Smooth_:
findings.problem: "Written with" credits Johnson as co-writer of the screenplay. None of C180's sources says that: Variety (S45) says the film is one she is "working on alongside" Burghardt, Wikipedia (S16) says it was "written by Vanessa Burghardt," and October 2025 trade reports describe the screenplay as Burghardt's feature writing debut. The typing argument does not depend on authorship, but the sentence misstates a creative credit for a named third party.
findings.acceptance_test: The clause reads "written by Vanessa Burghardt" (or drops the authorship, e.g. "a project with Vanessa Burghardt"), and C180's claim text and passage are updated to match; no other change.

findings.passage: her 2022 account came four years after the franchise ended and a year after _The Lost Daughter_, when distancing cost least.
findings.problem: The Lost Daughter premiered in September 2021 and was released in December 2021; the Vanity Fair account was reported in spring 2022 and published June 28, 2022, six to nine months later. "A year after" overstates the gap. The point (distancing cost least) stands either way.
findings.acceptance_test: The clause reads "months after _The Lost Daughter_" (or "half a year after"), and C140's claim text is updated to match.
